subject: Test case transfer, usage constraints and MAP milestones
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@ampliretail.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@ampliretail.com
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & asset exchange for evaluation — next steps

Hi Sofia / Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency numbers on the cart-recommendation workflow. Procurement asked me to capture next steps so we can get the evaluation assets and MAP in place. High level asks from our side: 

- Mutual Action Plan with milestones for dataset transfer, test execution windows, and sign-off dates.
- A secure mechanism to receive the prompt pack and test cases (SFTP or shared Drive link with time-limited access).
- Clarification on usage constraints and deletion/retention commitments — we cannot store raw customer PII beyond the evaluation window.

We are proposing a 3-week evaluation window starting as soon as the asset handoff occurs; procurement needs pricing and any temporary credits noted on the MAP.

Can you confirm that Redwood can:
1) provide a signed MAP with milestones, 
2) deliver the test-case manifest with scoped usage terms, and
3) provide an encrypted transfer option?

Appreciate a timeline so procurement can align internal approvals.

Best,
Ellen
Procurement Lead, AmpliRetail

Attachment: procurement_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@ampliretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & asset exchange for evaluation — next steps

Ellen — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: yes, yes, and yes.

I attached a first-pass MAP (ampliretail_mpa_draft_v1.pdf) plus a sample manifest to illustrate the fields we request (testcase_manifest_v3.csv). Key points in the draft:

- Kickoff: asset handoff (we propose secure SFTP + ephemeral Drive link)
- Staging window: 3 business days to ingest and sanity-check assets
- Evaluation window: default 21 days from handoff unless you request an earlier end date
- Output retention: Redwood will keep ephemeral outputs for 14 days post-eval unless you opt-in to longer retention; PII will be redacted on ingestion and we can support a hashed-only mode per your compliance team
- Usage constraints: assets are for evaluation only, no reproduction or redistribution; see clause 4.2 in the draft for permitted analysis types.

Requested actions from your side:
1) Confirm the transfer mechanism (SFTP hostname or Drive share) and point of contact for the file drop.
2) Identify any test cases that require masking at source (customer PII) so we can apply the ingestion pipeline accordingly.
3) Approve the MAP milestones or propose adjustments — especially the sign-off gate at day 21.

Next steps on our side: Dev will provision an ephemeral SFTP user scoped to your IP and Marissa will schedule the kickoff call and upload the runbook for execution.

If acceptable, can we target asset handoff on Wednesday 2027-11-03? That would give us a 2027-11-04 ingestion check and a 21-day evaluation ending 2027-11-25.

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

Attachments: ampliretail_mpa_draft_v1.pdf (MAP draft, 6 pages); testcase_manifest_v3.csv (CSV stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@ampliretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & asset exchange for evaluation — next steps

Ellen / team — adding a couple of contract-level clarifications from legal and PM:

- We can sign the MAP as an addendum to the evaluation terms (no full commercial contract required for the 21-day eval).
- Usage constraints: limited to internal evaluation and model-quality analysis; no production inference permitted. We will include a short-term license language.
- Data handling: Redwood will not retain raw user-identifying data in cleartext beyond the 14-day buffer; if AmpliRetail requires, we can accept a pre-masked dataset or apply deterministic hashing during ingestion.
- Audit trail: we will provide an ingestion log and simple run metrics (token counts, latencies) for the evaluation period.

Operational ask to AmpliRetail: please confirm the list of test-case IDs you will send (we'll reconcile them against the manifest). Also confirm 3 people who can approve the final report (technical lead, procurement, and product).

Sofia / Marissa — once we have the confirmed IDs and POC list, legal can finalize the MAP addendum.

Thanks,
Karthik
VP, Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@ampliretail.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: QA Labs <qa@qalabs.io>, procurement@ampliretail.com
Date: Thu, 04 Nov 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & asset exchange for evaluation — next steps

Thanks team — this looks good. Quick confirmations: 

- We will use SFTP (details to follow from our infra team) and will deliver the initial package by EOD Wednesday 2027-11-03 as proposed.
- Testcase IDs (first tranche): AR-TC-1001, AR-TC-1002, AR-TC-1003 — full manifest to follow.
- Approvers: Ellen Park (procurement), Rajiv Menon (tech lead), and Claire Ortiz (product).
- We require the 14-day deletion guarantee in writing — procurement will need that clause explicitly in the MAP addendum.

QA Labs will coordinate on a non-PII masked sample for the first ingest (they will send a 50-row sample to validate ingestion behavior).

Please send the SFTP user and a Drive link for the prompt pack sample. Also confirm whether Redwood will run the prompt pack under hashed-only mode for this run.

Ellen
Procurement Lead, AmpliRetail
